description: The Open Energy Data Initiative is the U.S. Department of Energy's catalogue and data lake for open energy research data, run on the OpenEI platform. At the time of reading it reported 2,841 datasets from 310 data providers, 4.8 petabytes of data and more than 133 million downloads, with featured collections such as the data lakes of large curated files, OEDI-SI for solar systems integration and power system simulation, and a siting lab for renewable energy facilities. For buildings it hosts, among others, the End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. building stock and the BuildingsBench data catalogued separately here. Coverage: mainly the United States, across energy sectors. Access: search and submission on the OEDI site, with large datasets in cloud storage. Licence: set per dataset. Caveats: quality, documentation and licences vary between submissions, so each dataset must be judged on its own page. Simulation uses are a first stop for U.S. building load profiles, stock models and energy system data. Related records: the End-Use Load Profiles and BuildingsBench records.
